gaps.next_text: We have not struggled and survived

gaps.prev_text: to be ruled and dominated by these resurrected gods.
gaps.next_text: Let them dance among the constellations as they wish,

gaps.prev_text: as long as they learn nothing of our designs.

cues.text: A lush, misty valley under a cloudy sky. A colossal white spacecraft hovers in the distance. In the foreground, several tall, robotic beings stand among the grass and trees. Their bodies are built from sharp, detached geometric shapes, with dark, ribbon-like tentacles trailing behind them.
One robot holds a glowing pink flower.
In the robot's palm, the delicate pink flower suddenly morphs into a glowing, angular white crystal.
The robot gazes at the floating, geometric gem. Its body is composed of dark, disconnected shards, anchored around the brightly glowing red core in its chest.

beats.note: A misty, green valley with a large white spaceship hovering in the background. Several tall robots with detached limbs and dark tentacles stand in the foreground.
The view pans right across the forest.
A close-up of one of the robots, revealing a glowing red core in its chest and a floating, geometric head.
It holds a glowing pink flower in its detached, floating hand.
The pink flower transforms into a bright, angular white crystal.
The robot continues to hold the glowing crystal in the dim forest.
